title: Representation-Independent Galois Barriers for Rank-1-Hessian Lorentz Systems, Optimal (k+2)-Site Turnpike Rulers, Sharp Mixed-Radix Freiman Compression, and Rational SDP Witnesses
abstract: Given positive integers a_1,...,a_k and K, let S = sum_{i=1}^k sqrt(a_i) and Delta = S - K. Elder (arXiv:2611.34535v1) built a (k+3)-site Turnpike ruler with sep(Y) <= |Delta| and gap_*(Y) <= |Delta| (Proposition 1), reduced radical-sum Turnpike to integer Turnpike via a uniform base-(2M+1) Freiman isomorphism (Theorem 4), gave order-(2k+1) rational affine PSD pencils L_{a_i}, U_{a_i} (Proposition 5), and checked that for these specific encodings the Lorentz squared-residual Hessians span a k-dimensional space outside OpenAI's Corollary 7 whenever k > 1. We sharpen and generalize every pillar of Elder's framework in three constructively verified theorems. First, we establish a representation-independent Galois-theoretic classification: any rational affine Lorentz system of arbitrary dimension whose squared-residual Hessians span a subspace of dimension <= 1 linearizes onto a single rational quadric t = x^T Q x, forcing every attained rational-linear extreme value to have algebraic degree <= 2 over Q (even for indefinite or singular Hessians); by Kummer theory and Besicovitch's theorem, [Q(S):Q] = 2^rho where rho = dim_{F_2} span_{F_2}{[tilde d_j]} <= r_irr is the multiplicative Kummer F_2-rank of the r_irr distinct non-square square-free classes, and since rho <= 1 iff r_irr <= 1, S admits an attained rank-1-Hessian-span Lorentz formulation of any size if and only if r_irr <= 1 (ruling out all rational reformulations for r_irr >= 2). Second, we eliminate the auxiliary gap B from Proposition 1 to obtain a strictly minimal (k+2)-site ruler saving k+2 distances for all k >= 1, and replace Elder's uniform radix 2M+1 in Theorem 4 with per-coordinate mixed radices beta_j = 2M_j + 1, compressing bit-lengths from r log_2(2M+1) to sum_j log_2(2M_j+1) while proving beta_j = 2M_j + 1 (1 <= j <= r-1) is strictly necessary and sufficient for carry-free Freiman preservation. Third, via the exact field Galois norm N_{E/Q}(S-K) in Z\{0} and a {0,1}-gap-indicator envelope, we prove constant-free lower bounds |Delta| >= (K+S)^{-(2^rho - 1)}, sep(Y) >= (K+S)^{-(2^rho - 1)}, and gap_*(Y) >= (2K+2S)^{-(2^rho - 1)}, and construct explicit dyadic rational SDP witnesses of bit-length O(2^rho L) certifying L_{a_i} > 0 (S < K) or U_{a_i} > 0 (S > K), contrasted with irrationality of equality witnesses when any a_i is non-square. All 20 theorems are formalized in constructive Lean 4.35.0 (0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice) alongside 16 zero-float SHA-256 certificates and 56 adversarial tests.
